name: "Towny • Survival • Economy • PvP"
description:
🔥 Vatra — a Ukrainian PvP survival server (1.9–26.1.2) with Towny, communities, and city-building!

🧭 Getting started: use /rtp (every 15 minutes), gather resources, and set off on your adventure.

🏗️ Towns (Towny): create your own nation or join a new one and expand your districts.

🛡️ Safety: PvP is enabled everywhere except spawn and towns (configurable).

⏳ Eras: server progression—each era unlocks new limits (chunks/claims) and extra bonuses.

💰 Economy: global /shop, player shops /pshop, and voting rewards.

⚔️ 1v1 Duels: challenge a rival with /duel—quick, fair fights away from gank chaos.

📱💻 Cross-play: Java + Bedrock (Geyser & Floodgate)—play together from phone and PC.

🧭 Navigation & info: NPC menus (Citizens + DeluxeMenus), hologram signs (DecentHolograms), and /translate for smooth UA/EN chat.

🛡️ Fair play: Vulcan detects cheats; CoreProtect lets admins roll back damage. WorldBorder is enabled; building in the wilderness is allowed.

🗺️ Live map (Pl3xMap): check the world online, plan roads and borders.

Rules (short):

🤝 Respect others—no toxicity, spam, or advertising.

🚫 No cheats, x-rays, macros, dupes, or exploits.

🏙️ Griefing in towns is forbidden; 🌾 raids and PvP are allowed in the wild.

🏷️ Town/nation names must be appropriate; in disputes, the admin team has the final say.

📘 Full rules (including English) are in the in-game Information menu.

Quick commands: /rtp /shop /pshop /duel /translate /vote

✨ Join Vatra, build a legendary city, and etch your name into the server’s history!
